final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_count) AS average_count FROM circuit_counts GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.race_count, CAST(cc.race_count AS REAL) / ca.average_count FROM circuit_counts AS cc JOIN country_averages AS ca ON cc.country = ca.country ORDER BY CAST(cc.race_count AS REAL) / ca.average_count DESC LIMIT 10
